title: Non-gating CI workflows (nightly advisory, lockfile audit, release checksums)

evidence.note: these three workflows are outside the gating override; the planner selects the repo-governance job set, and this scheme certifies exactly that set

author: ai
rationale: Editing a non-gating workflow cannot affect kernel or UI behaviour; the six repository-governance checks are sufficient, so ready PRs no longer need the full matrix.
